prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='THETA', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) but fails at seasonality (-0.06), while THETA excels at seasonality (0.32) but ignores trend (0.0). This complementary pattern suggests STL-hierarchical stacking can exploit additive decomposition. High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio=1.96) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.10) further support decomposition-aware methods over simple averaging.
